design_challenges.title: Rule and measurement transitions create coupled adaptation lag
design_challenges.issue: Changed rules/measurement can create uneven retraining, role value, and market-price transitions.
design_challenges.owner_decision: Decide whether adaptation lag is lifecycle, latent modifier, or era marker.

design_challenges.title: Development networks can be expanded, shared, or reconfigured
design_challenges.issue: Farm, academy, college, winter, and regional systems have capacity and knowledge-flow states not yet bounded.
design_challenges.owner_decision: Choose a small capacity/network state without spreadsheet overhead.

design_challenges.title: Institutional player-access routes can reverse
design_challenges.issue: Posting, foreign slots, transfer, draft eligibility, and travel gates can open, expire, reverse, or grandfather a cohort.
design_challenges.owner_decision: Set abstraction and grandfathering rules for institutional reversals.

design_challenges.title: Media and stadium resilience can decouple resources from wins
design_challenges.issue: Stadium, merger, media-rights failure, and league fallback can change resources independently of wins.
design_challenges.owner_decision: Decide whether resilience is rare default, owner toggle, or background-only.

design_challenges.title: Integrity governance must cover officials and institutional response
design_challenges.issue: Integrity needs evidence tiers, official scope, investigation duration, differentiated sanctions, and trust repair.
design_challenges.owner_decision: Set safe content boundary and simulation-safe official/equipment cases.

design_challenges.title: Era markers are needed for statistical and legacy comparability
design_challenges.issue: Rule, ball, weather-format, and labor-calendar transitions make raw records incomparable without erasing history.
design_challenges.owner_decision: Choose visibility of transition markers in default history/news views.

design_challenges.title: Contract timing and governance clauses affect the competitive window
design_challenges.issue: Nominal value, cash timing, options, opt-outs, and governance contingencies are contract/finance mechanisms.
design_challenges.owner_decision: Decide whether timing/clauses affect finance only or negotiation and competitive windows.

design_challenges.title: Tiered competition and promotion/relegation are a global false-negative repair
design_challenges.issue: Wave 1 found European promotion/relegation but absorbed it into broad league-growth IDs; explicit tier movement is not stated in the ledger.
design_challenges.owner_decision: Decide whether tier movement is background-only or an owner-toggle regional system.
